liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (2 reviews): Reviewer thinks this may be the best Greatest Story Ever Told the band ever played; Described as one of the best versions, alongside a strong So Many Roads [13][19]
- **So Many Roads** (2 reviews): Reviewer counts this So Many Roads among personal favorites, with Jerry's voice strong throughout the show; Singled out as one of the best versions, especially Jerry's singing at the end [11][12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Second set opens with a hot China-Rider, a nice transition jam and very good solos [19]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Show is said to contain a great Terrapin [13]
- **Way to Go Home** (1 review): Reviewer docks a star because Wave to the Wind and Way to Go Home both appear after a set ending with Eternity and Liberty [17]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): The Other One into Dew is called underrated, especially the Dew [17]
- **The Weight** (1 review): Reviewer highlights The Weight as a strong show-closing encore [12]

## The recordings

- **gd93-03-25.aud.stine.14831.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 27 songs; 228 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd93-03-25.sbd.nawrocki.16433.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4.07/5 by 15 [2]. Said about its sound: Nawrocki matrix is judged better than the other source, which seems to be an analog generation in set one; Minor audio anomalies at the beginning of the recording don't detract from enjoyment [11][16]
- **gd93-03-25.msbd.keyser.25820.sbefail.flacf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1993-03-25.sbd.delgado-nawrocki.3191.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min [5]. Said about its sound: Source DAT had many clicks, mostly between Women Are Smarter and Wave to the Wind, largely removed [5]

## Around the show

- Phil was very angry about the patch being given to the 3/24 section, while Healey was laughing about it [14]
- Phil was very angry about the patch being given to the 3/24 section, while Healey was laughing about it [15]
- Seats near the snack bar were bad, with a TV showing a college basketball game distracting from listening [18]
- The arena was brand new and the sound in the building was excellent [19]
- Reviewer witnessed a near riot at the Chapel Hill shows, though it didn't spoil the show [21]
- Second Chapel Hill night is often overshadowed by the first night and includes many songs then new to the band [11]
- Show is overlooked because of the previous night, yet has both old and newer songs [12]
- Less well known than the previous night's show, and somewhat heavy on newer material [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-03-25.aud.stine.14831.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Wally Stine; transferred by Wally Stine; source: Audience: Nakamichi 300's [1]. Also: Taped by Wally Stine from the taper section with Nak 300s at 8 feet into a Sony D3; Transfer went from DAT through SBLive, CDWave and MKW Audio Tools to SHN; circulated from ibiblio tunetree [1]
- **gd93-03-25.sbd.nawrocki.16433.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > D10proII [2]. Also: Taper recounts how the board patch happened: he was running from Erdheim's rig when handed XLR cables and found signal using a D-10P [14]
- **gd93-03-25.msbd.keyser.25820.sbefail.flacf**: taped by James Young; transferred by Ron Keyser; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Taper recounts how the board patch happened: he was running from Erdheim's rig when handed XLR cables and found signal using a D-10P [15]
- **gd1993-03-25.sbd.delgado-nawrocki.3191.shnf**: transferred by Doug Nawrocki; source: *SBD>DAT [5]. Also: Soundboard patch began only at the third song, So Many Roads; first two tunes were patched with an audience source [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Dean Smith Center - March 25, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/march-25-1993) [24]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-03-24 Dean Smith Center, Chapel Hill, NC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-03-24-dean-smith-center-chapel-hill-nc-usa/) [25]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1993-03-25 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1993-03-25-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [26]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Grateful Dead - Univeristy of North Carolina](https://www.dead.net/archives/1993/photos/grateful-dead-univeristy-north-carolina) [27]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1993-03-25 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1993-03-25-grateful-dead-ticket/) [28]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Dean Smith Center - March 25, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/march-25-1993) [29]
